experiment_data.hypothesis: Random reweight baseline: shuffling q_scores before computing adaptive weights destroys the detector's contamination signal while preserving the weight distribution shape. If adaptive (PPL=17.674) outperforms random reweight, the detector signal is load-bearing and not just a regularization artifact.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/provenance_weight_training && PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 WANDB_MODE=disabled python -u training/pretrain_weighted.py --data_path data/scored_data_random_shuffle.jsonl --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/models/random_reweight_baseline_seed42 --model_name models/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --weighting_method adaptive --contamination_ratio 0.4 --tau 0.8 --num_train_tokens 200000000 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 4 --learning_rate 5e-5 --max_length 2048 --seed 42 --save_steps 500 --logging_steps 10 --bf16 --save_total_limit 3"
